entries.title: Short Pullback Continuation Directional Asymmetry and Historical Portability Study
entries.causal_hypothesis: Downtrend pullback continuation has a delayed right-tail payoff structure that differs from the Long counterpart and should reproduce in 2020-2022 and 2025.
entries.origin_analysis: HYP-036 source-native side attribution placed nearly all pooled profit in Short. This was discovery evidence for an independent unseen-period portability question, not permission to alter HYP-036.
pre_result_predictions: positive at least 2/3 years and 4/6 half-years
retained_findings: Short and Long have similar pullback/confirmation geometry in 2023-2024.
Short shows materially larger MFE and positive late-horizon mean returns despite worse early returns and MAE.
The mechanism remains plausible but unconfirmed.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: No portability claim was scientifically tested because the first binding historical source authority was unresolved.
prohibited_reuse: Do not count 2023-2024 as HYP-037 confirmation.
Do not substitute MT4/HST or another venue for unresolved Dukascopy authority.
Do not change side, EMA, ATR, tolerance, hold, execution, session, period or lot during technical repair.
Do not access 2025 before all pre-2025 gates pass.
successor_questions: Can complete immutable 2020-2022 Dukascopy BI5 monthly authority be acquired under the unchanged contract?
entries.decision_note: Technical stop before historical candidate outcome construction. HYP-036 remains closed and unchanged.
